query:
update exemplaires
        set contenu = jsonb_set(contenu, '{texte}', to_jsonb($2::text)),
            passages_abimes = $3,
            passages_reecrits = $4,
            sceau_id = $5,
            sceau_etat = $6,
            signature_etat = $7,
            signature_nom = $8,
            signature_ecriture_id = $9,
            signature_personnage_id = $10,
            faussaire_personnage_id = $11,
            faussaire_ecriture_id = $12,
            remarque_texte = $13,
            remarque_sceau = $14,
            remarque_signature = $15,
            modifie_le = now()
        where id = $1
